scope: Continuation of fixed V15 and R50, source-original Road5→Road6 B51-13→14; no high-level change. One bounded near-bank receiver-placement hypothesis, not an ART or DCC authoring candidate.

method.question: Could the lower catchment be positioned on the CAMERA-FACING side of protected source forebay19 instead of hidden behind the R50 cliff / old R48 R49 shelf?
method.camera: Original camera coordinate matrices for source 240Hz ticks 15900,15924,15972 at 66.25/66.35/66.55 seconds from R38 digest-verified original Chromium artifact.
method.projection: R41 approximate 505x350 half-resolution perspective-correct software z buffer, all 32,004 original R44 real Blender triangles; no culling, fog or native GL state; near-plane crossing omitted.
method.receiverHypothesis: Single flat water visibility probe per site; center d/t as below, receiver y72 (~21m below source), extent 20m cross-shore x24m longitudinal. NOT a physical pond, hydraulic seal, machinery or authored art.
method.bounds: Finite visibility feasibility ONLY; 12 sites not exhaustive and no human legibility pixel threshold claimed. Existing source real RAW were viewed, but hypothetical receiver was not run in original WebGL2.

bestLimitedSite.caveat: Group16/24 are nonprotected existing R44 geometry, so redesigning them could remove this particular last occlusion; however even the optimistic protected-only projected lower receiver remains only a thin strip, with no proven source connection, open 21m drop or supported working machine.

criticalEvaluation.positive: Previous R50 low catchment at d120-185 y52 had zero visibility against protected8. This limited alternative found a narrow outboard location with nonzero protected-only visibility, so the broad 'protected geometry makes any lower pool impossible' claim is NOT justified.
criticalEvaluation.negative: Neither source→true drop→receiving water nor a supported machine is readable in native game images. The sole strongest projected catchment is tiny under protected-only depth and disappears entirely behind existing complete DCC geometry; natural gameplay/B51 awareness is untested for the hypothetical overlay.
criticalEvaluation.scopeOfNoGo: This family of 12 positions at Y72 only. Not a proof of impossibility for all source-connected architectures, and not evidence of a true GL scene.
criticalEvaluation.stop: Do not author another R48/R49-style siphon or color shelf, do not run Blender or CI merely to increase projected RGB, and do not modify protected water19/tower12/original game/camera/road.
criticalEvaluation.next: Only proceed to one distinct authored candidate once an actual camera-safe source-to-fall-to-catchment sightline with grounded mechanical supports is justified; prefer a different cross section and existing nonprotected obstruction analysis rather than more narrow-tint masks. Original B51 failure→retry→avoid remains next essential game-play gate after credible ART.
